verdict.rationale: Luma's Modify Video V2 is explicitly positioned for reshaping existing footage: swapping specific elements (wall, world, wardrobe) while lighting and performance are preserved. Related claims cover transforming people into new characters while keeping the performance. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how a creator targets or isolates a single element (masking or region selection) and how well untouched areas are guaranteed to stay intact, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration of Modify Video results.

support.subject: As a creator, I can replace or restyle an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact

citations.quote: Modify Video V2 reshapes footage you already have. Swap the wall, the world, the wardrobe. The lighting holds. The performance survives.
Transform people into entirely new characters while preserving performance.
Adapt products across campaigns without reshoots or manual editing.
